records.note: BEA advance estimate: real GDP +3.4% annualized in Q3 versus +2.2% in Q2; real final sales to private domestic purchasers +4.9%; PCE price index +2.1%; core PCE +2.5%. Advance estimate is subject to revision. No direct XRP causal link.

records.title: Binance uncovers wider breach in $6.3 billion exploit, targets Sunday withdrawal restart
records.note: CoinDesk reports Binance's investigation found multiple breach points, EIP-7702 delegation and self-destruct tooling; withdrawals targeted before Sunday, around 40 hours from the statement; initial PoR view possibly before a fuller Monday report. Secondary reporting; distinguish company statements from CoinDesk analysis.

records.title: Security Incident Update
records.note: Binance's official initial update says investigation may involve a compromised DevOps engineer laptop and service container, no evidence of wallet private-key leakage, estimated incident impact about $6.3B, about $3B frozen on-chain, losses covered by SAFU and company funds, deposits/withdrawals temporarily suspended, and updated PoR after remediation.

records.title: Richard Teng: Binance reserves $6.34 billion to cover losses; $5 billion already held in affected tokens
records.note: Verified Binance News account reports $6.34B company reserve, $5B already held in exact affected tokens, remaining roughly $1.34B to be acquired through market and OTC channels, approximately $3B frozen separately, withdrawals targeted before Sunday/within about 40 hours, and PoR update by Monday. Aggregate figures; no XRP-specific purchase or execution breakdown.

records.title: Ripple XRP breaks below $1.25 as Ripple freezes hacker's RLUSD and moves 310 million XRP
records.note: ICOBench reports the attacker receiver still held 233,461,943 XRP with no outgoing transfer as of 14:40 UTC, and reports 310M XRP in Ripple-associated wallet movements. It says no ledger link to the Binance hack. This is secondary reporting; the receiver was not independently refreshed after 14:40 UTC in this run, and the Ripple movement transaction hashes were not independently inspected.

records.title: Whale Alert public transaction alerts for Ripple-associated XRP movements on 2026-10-30
records.note: Whale Alert posts referenced by ICOBench report 99,999,999 XRP and 90,000,001 XRP entering a Ripple-associated wallet at 08:19 and 08:27 UTC, followed by 120,000,000 XRP leaving at 08:30 UTC. These alerts are not transaction-hash verification; no purpose, exchange destination or sale is established.
